summary: Make governed delivery diagnose new-project layouts

delivery.outcome: Goal recognizes adopted new-project targets versus the source hub, keeps governance verification read-only, and surfaces canonical diagnostic remediation
nonGoals: No change to adoption generation, release metadata or dependencies
No attempt to emulate the source hub validator when its own target wrapper is inapplicable
No new CLI command or automatic opening of runbook files

architecture.decision: Centralize package-layout preflight and v1/v2 diagnostic lookup in the existing delivery adapter, then reuse it from the existing governance CLI
architecture.rollback: Restore wrapper-only gate dispatch and mutable callback configuration loading

validation.evidence: layout preflight rejects incomplete targets and source hubs before executing a target wrapper
governance verification and hook authorization never create or rewrite goal.yaml
v2 remediation and linked .governance/error runbooks are surfaced while v1 remains compatible

commands: ruff check goal/governance/delivery.py goal/cli/governance_cmd.py tests/test_governance_delivery.py tests/test_governance_cmd.py
validation.evidence: focused/full tests, lint, governance and package/container builds pass
